about_the_game:
Hidden Portals: Eternal Balance Collector's Edition is a gripping hidden-object puzzle adventure where you dive into a mystical world on the brink of destruction. Join Alice Lofton as she unravels the secrets of an ancient artifact that bends time itself. Solve intricate puzzles, uncover hidden secrets, and race against time to save reality from falling apart.

Time is shattering, collapsing in unpredictable ways, erasing entire moments from existence. Alice Lofton, a skilled manuscript restorer, uncovers her father’s desperate plan to wield the legendary Clock of Harmony and bring back his lost wife. But tampering with time comes at a cost.

To stop him, Alice must enter the mystical realm of Luminaria, a world where reality itself is unraveling. With a reluctant ally and a fearless resistance leader by her side, she must race against time to restore balance before the past consumes the future.

Will Alice save her father before his obsession destroys everything? Or will time itself fall apart?
